incidente.resumo: A loss in telemetry cascaded to security policies being mistakenly applied to backend storage accounts in GitHub's underlying compute provider; the policies blocked access to critical VM metadata, so VM create, delete and reimage operations failed and GitHub Actions hosted runners and Codespaces were unavailable in all regions, along with other features using that compute. Service was restored by rolling back the policy changes, after which runners worked through the backlog.

descricao.texto: A loss in telemetry cascaded to security policies being mistakenly applied to backend storage accounts in the underlying compute provider; those policies blocked access to critical VM metadata, causing all VM create, delete, reimage and other operations to fail.
trechos: This outage was caused by a loss in telemetry that cascaded to mistakenly applying security policies to backend storage accounts in our underlying compute provider.
Those policies blocked access to critical VM metadata, causing all VM create, delete, reimage, and other operations to fail.

descricao.texto: Security policy changes mistakenly applied to backend storage accounts in the underlying compute provider.
trechos: This outage was caused by a loss in telemetry that cascaded to mistakenly applying security policies to backend storage accounts in our underlying compute provider.
This was mitigated by rolling back the policy changes, which started at 22:15 UTC.

passos.texto: The policy changes were rolled back, starting at 22:15 UTC; as VMs came back online, the runners worked through the backlog of requests that had not timed out.
trechos: This was mitigated by rolling back the policy changes, which started at 22:15 UTC.

acoes.texto: Work with the compute provider to improve incident response and engagement time, improve early detection, and ensure safe rollout should similar changes occur in the future.
trechos: We are working with our compute provider to improve our incident response and engagement time, improve early detection, and ensure safe rollout should similar changes occur in the future.

On February 2, 2026, between 18:35 UTC and 22:20 UTC, GitHub Actions hosted runners and GitHub Codespaces were unavailable, with service degraded until full recovery at 23:10 UTC for standard runners, February 3, 2026 at 00:30 UTC for larger runners, and February 3 at 00:15 for codespaces.

observacoes: The document is GitHub's February 2026 availability report covering six incidents; only the February 2 compute/runner incident is extracted. duracao covers the stated unavailability window 18:35-22:20 UTC; service stayed degraded until full recovery at 23:10 UTC (standard runners), 00:15 UTC on February 3 (Codespaces) and 00:30 UTC on February 3 (larger runners). The section heading gives 'February 02 19:03 UTC (lasting 5 hours and 53 minutes)', which starts after the stated impact start and is not used as the impact duration. The text points to more information elsewhere ('More information is available here') that is not in the extracted text.
